notes.title: FURIDASHI - UPDATE RELEASED! Version 121 Build 17
notes.notes:
1. Improved car physics. The control became more responsive and the cars in drift are more smooth. The transmission and communication of the engine with wheels have been redesigned.
The gearbox settings for all cars in the garage are reset to the new default values

2. 10 Exhaust systems and 3 Turbo kits sounding differently are available for installation on each car.
In combination with 10 engines, which have a unique sound, 300 variants of the car sound are obtained.
You can install the components on the car to your taste

3. Added a new track - HIGASHI JAPAN

4. 5 DLCs with new premium cars are released in full pumping and with unique designs

5. 20 new exclusive designs for Premium cars are added.

6. 11 new music tracks

7. Ability to control the steering wheel of the car with the mouse

8. Added indicator of the steering wheel position. Can be enabled in the SETTINGS>GAMEPLAY menu. It is displayed only when the steer is assigned to an analog controller (steering wheel, stick, mouse)

9. Car horn signal has been added. Additional convenient means of communication of players online

10. Function of Recovery the car on the track. Assign a button in the SETTINGS>CONTROLS menu.

11. Description of technical settings in TUNING menu

12. Fixed many bugs, increased stability of the game client.

notes.title: FULL OPTIMIZATION UPDATE - VERSION 211 BUILD 31
notes.notes:
Update with full optimization of graphics and logic processes has been released.
The game should run with more FPS. The most particularly noticeable increase should be when using reduced anti-aliasing. The game became less demanding on the characteristics of CPU.

Work on optimization required us a lot of time and effort.
But the result is achieved. And we are happy that we can please the players.

notes.title: New version 211 have released!
notes.notes:
* No in-game credits any more! All cars available for in-game dollars.
  Additional cars are grouped in DLC packs. Сars have become much cheaper!
  All customization parts (wheels, spoilers, objects, body kits) available for in-game dollars! 
  For players who have bought credits before provides the compensation and gift all the DLC for free!

* New 4 localized game servers:
  - USA Dallas
  - Germany Frankfurt
  - China Hong Kong (will be available in next 2-3 days)
  - Russia Moscow
  Please choose the server location nearest you to play with minimal web delays.
  Profiles at all game servers are independent. So just choose the best server for game career development.

* Car physics corrections for tires modul.

* Fixed a lot of bugs and improved the game client

notes.title: RELEASE ON STEAM
notes.notes:
Peak Angle: Drift Online was released on Steam!

Players who have bought the game before release can get free key to activate the game on Steam and continue playing in old profile.
Request key to your previously paid account here:
http://peakangle.com/?page_id=1420
To continue playing the previously existing profile you must import it into a new version of the game. To do this in the main menu select the item “Import Profile” and enter the details of your profile.
In case of successful query will be given a key to activate the Steam product.
To activate the need to run the Steam client and in the bottom left corner click the “+ Add Game” -> “Activate on Steam” and follow the instructions.
